prepareInstallation.description: Deploys a ContentCourt wired to the DAO's RepToken, timelock and treasury.

inputs.name: economy
inputs.description: The Economy whose appeal window verdicts wait out.

components.name: caseDeposit
components.description: Deposit to contest a label. Returned unless the verdict goes against the opener.

components.name: thresholdBps
components.description: Committed juror REP that closes a case for reveal.

components.name: reviewWindow
components.description: How long a case can stay below the threshold before it lapses.

components.name: revealWindow
components.description: Time jurors have to reveal their votes.

components.name: degradeBps
components.description: REP a juror loses for voting against the verdict or not revealing.

components.name: assertionSlashBps
components.description: REP a member loses for an off-chain label on the losing side.

prepareUninstallation.description: Revokes the court's slashing rights and clears its registry entries.
